motivation: direct exportImage image streaming failed even for the geometry-only-selected 82x47 native-cell pilot; official ArcGIS exportImage also supports f=json returning an href to the generated image resource
pilot_rule: reuse exactly the already locked geometry-only-selected pilot and its source-native aligned population window
success_gate: exportImage f=json must return HTTP 200 parseable JSON with href, width, height, and extent matching the locked request dimensions; following href must return a TIFF whose raster metadata is one band, EPSG:3395, 100 m grid and whose byte size is below GitHub file limits
decision_rule: if JSON indirection succeeds, preregister a separate equivalence/materialization amendment before any cross-geography population values; if it fails, population exposure remains transport-blocked
